strata_specifics.ground_texture: Smooth, light-grey sandstone riverbed stones with soft rounded edges and blackish organic shale bands

layer_3_action.subject: Fukuiraptor
features: slender elongated skull with a slightly pointed snout
small raised decorative clay ridges above the eyes
large alert expressive yellow eyes with a curious gaze
exceptionally strong forelimbs featuring significantly oversized curved megaraptoran black hand claws
standard, blunt three-toed walking feet with regular weight-bearing claws
sleek muscular bipedal frame with a long horizontal counter-balancing tail
electric-yellow accent tones along the throat
smooth seamless slate-blue matte clay-like skin
layer_3_action.action: A calm, highly inquisitive Fukuiraptor with clean, high-poly clay geometry is navigating a dry, rocky riverbed. It stands balanced on its hind legs, tilting its head curiously while raising one forelimb slightly to clearly showcase the silhouette of its signature oversized, curved black hand claws without any menacing posture or snarls. The camera captures it from a gentle three-quarter angle at eye-level, highlighting its sleek athletic frame. The background features stylized Early Cretaceous river valley ferns and soft studio lighting with clean ambient occlusion. No text.
